control.title: Clock synchronisation (NIC / NPL NTP)
control.description: Synchronise all system clocks to NTP sources traceable to NIC or NPL (for example time.nplindia.org or samay1.nic.in) so log timestamps are reliable.

implementation_notes: Logs shipped to our SIEM in ap-south-1 and retained for 180 days.
evidence_hint: NTP configuration on servers and cloud time service documentation.
acceptance_criteria: Servers and cloud services synchronise time with a reliable source (NIC or NPL NTP, or the cloud provider's time service)
Configuration is shown for production systems

requirements.title: Synchronise ICT system clocks
requirements.guidance: Connect to the NTP servers of the National Informatics Centre (NIC) or National Physical Laboratory (NPL), or to NTP servers traceable to them. Organisations across geographies may use other accurate sources if they do not deviate from NIC/NPL.

requirements.title: Anomaly monitoring
requirements.guidance: Monitor system components for anomalies that indicate malicious acts or errors.
